# DAKSHESH.

> DAKSHESH. is a one-person digital practice in India offering web development, SEO and digital growth, AI chatbots and business automation.

The site is a single page. Projects are labelled as live, in development, proof or demonstration.

## Services

- [Web Development](/#services): fast, polished websites and online stores
- [SEO & Digital Growth](/#services): technical SEO, site structure and content
- [AI & Chatbots](/#services): assistants that answer common questions and hand over to a person
- [Business Automation](/#services): workflows for scheduling, messaging and tracking

## Projects

- [Projects](/#projects): Cristova Biosciences (live), THE DECOR CULT and PeakDrop (in development), an n8n-style workflow demonstration and an interactive WhatsApp Business chatbot

## Contact

- [Contact](/#contact): WhatsApp, mail and Instagram
